column1: # Snippets: say the cue on its own and the text is pasted instead.
# Copy this file to ~/.config/sayit/snippets.tsv (or point SNIPPETS in .env at
# another file) and replace the examples with your own.
# One snippet per line: the cue, a TAB, the text. The whole dictation must be
# the cue; case and the punctuation at either end do not matter. In the text,
# \n is a line break, \t a tab and \\ a backslash.
